head: 29cafba67c8060f036024175590e7cf8740d7094
scope: Independent exact-head source review only; no gameplay, native RCON, supervisor, or campaign-state operation was performed.
source_evidence: Verified HEAD is exactly 29cafba67c8060f036024175590e7cf8740d7094. The complete diff against main changes only controller.py, telemetry.py, the synthetic receipt helper, and attempt tests; git diff --check is clean.

The prior persistence defect is repaired: telemetry.validate_attempt now admits zero_effect_transfer_reconciled only as a finished factory_insert or factory_extract outcome, while retaining the existing identity, timing, and provenance checks. CampaignMemory.load validates finished outcomes, so the new outcome can be durably resumed.

The successful zero-receipt regression test reloads the post-reconciliation checkpoint and asserts that pending, active_plan, and attempt are cleared and that the persisted zero_effect_transfer_reconciled outcome equals the completed in-memory outcome.

controller._unacknowledged_transfer_receipt admits a zero receipt only for a live FLE snapshot with an ambiguous, origin=new transfer attempt whose action, plan id, step index, receipt, live bound actor, role/item/direction, expected machine unit, receipt unit, and receipt tick all match. Checkpoint loading additionally binds the attempt fingerprint and receipt to the retained active-plan step.

For a zero insert, the gate requires exact costs of the requested item and quantity, an exactly matching reservation, and current inventory retaining at least the full requested source. For a zero extract, it requires no costs, an empty exact reservation, and current machine output retaining the full requested source. Missing source retention or an unbound actor remains uncertain in the added tests.

After an eligible zero receipt, _verify_pending records zero_effect_transfer_reconciled, finishes the attempt, and calls _fail_plan, which clears the retained plan and reservation before returning the reconcile record. It does not invoke backend execution; the zero-receipt test proves the dispatch call count remains one.

No fairness-affecting code is changed. The retained fair and factory Lua paths still require the original bound connected character, game.speed == 1, no cheat mode, and normal reach for mining and transfers; the PR adds no teleport, speed change, fast movement/mining, remote interaction, or item-grant mechanism.
